A number $a$ is bao-good if there exist $s, l$ such that:
1. $s^b \not\equiv l \pmod a$ for all $b \ge 1$.
2. For every proper divisor $a'$ of $a$, there exists $b \ge 1$ such that $s^b \equiv l \pmod{a'}$.
